Good-quality rack. Great for home or small business use
Finally found a decent sized rack. Most of the new stuff isn't deep enough for older servers, this works perfectly, doubted it's strength to start with, but it's really solid once finished.

Great piece of equipment, it did not disappoint, the metal uses good quality. The only complaint is it is a little hard to put together and also a little hard to figure out how long to make it. But once your past that its great, I have two servers and a dream machine pro on it with no issues. This could also be used for sound equipment which would be nice since it comes with wheels to move it around easier. Overall great product!
